description: This file defines the class PublisherDelete, which manages deletion of pages in a Confluence publishing context, including listing deletable pages and performing deletions via a client.

classes.name: PublisherDelete
classes.description: A class responsible for listing and deleting pages in Confluence, utilizing an output interface for user communication and a client for API interactions, with functionality to list deletable pages and delete them if authorized.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the output interface, delete flag, API client, and an internal array for deletable pages.

methods.name: listDeletable
methods.description: Recursively builds a list of pages that can be deleted based on provided published data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process deletable pages: lists or deletes based on the delete flag.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Performs deletion of pages identified as deletable via the API client.

methods.name: displayDeletable
methods.description: Displays the list of pages that are currently considered deletable without deleting them.
